name: Unidentified RA-7 protocol droid (Imperial-class Star Destroyer)
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified RA-7 protocol droid (Imperial-class Star Destroyer)
description: During the reign of the Galactic Empire, an RA-7 protocol droid served aboard an Imperial-class Star Destroyer. There, at one point the droid encountered a smuggler who had escaped from detention and wanted to retrieve their starship's impounded cargo. The droid begged the smuggler to spare his life and pointed them to a way to access the Star Destroyer's cargo bay.
